name: [W2] +1 Double Jump Bike Escape! 🚴💨
desc:
🎀 Join the ChillyTea Studio group to unlock a FREE exclusive item!

🚲 Welcome to +1 Bike Flip Escape! 🚲

⚡ Gain +1 Speed every time you move and gain extra double jumps!
👟 Ride your bike, perform awesome tricks, and escape through exciting biomes
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful new bikes
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Climb the leaderboards and become the FASTEST player on the server
🚀 Speed is everything, but one wrong move could send you all the way back to the start! 😱

Think you have what it takes to reach the end?

🤝 Created in collaboration with Crafti Studios
